title: It is not obvious from any menu that burning the Hollow Throne with Ironbound oil is compatible with (and does not erase) having just extracted the first Reeve's confession - the game explicitly comments on this tension in the epilogue ('He confessed, four hundred years late - and the throne burned anyway'), but nothing in the throne room itself warns that the confession doesn't block or discourage the fire ending.
